from pysat.solvers import Glucose4
from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType

n = 23
# Variables:
# x[i] -> i+1 (1 to 23)
# y[i] -> 23+i+1 (24 to 46)
# For each k in 1..11, for each i in 0..22:
# a_{k,i} = (x[i] == x[i+k]) -> 46 + (k-1)*46 + i + 1
# b_{k,i} = (y[i] == y[i+k]) -> 46 + (k-1)*46 + 23 + i + 1

solver = Glucose4()
vpool = 46

def get_var():
    global vpool
    vpool += 1
    return vpool

# Sum of x = 12 ones
x_vars = list(range(1, 24))
y_vars = list(range(24, 47))

cnf_x = CardEnc.equals(lits=x_vars, bound=12, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
vpool = cnf_x.nv
for clause in cnf_x.clauses:
    solver.add_clause(clause)

cnf_y = CardEnc.equals(lits=y_vars, bound=12, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
vpool = cnf_y.nv
for clause in cnf_y.clauses:
    solver.add_clause(clause)

for k in range(1, 12):
    eq_vars = []
    for i in range(n):
        # a_{k,i} <-> x[i] == x[i+k]
        a = get_var()
        eq_vars.append(a)
        x1 = x_vars[i]
        x2 = x_vars[(i+k)%n]
        # a <-> (x1 == x2)
        # a -> (x1 v -x2) & (-x1 v x2)
        # -a -> (x1 v x2) & (-x1 v -x2)
        solver.add_clause([-a, x1, -x2])
        solver.add_clause([-a, -x1, x2])
        solver.add_clause([a, x1, x2])
        solver.add_clause([a, -x1, -x2])
        
        # b_{k,i} <-> y[i] == y[i+k]
        b = get_var()
        eq_vars.append(b)
        y1 = y_vars[i]
        y2 = y_vars[(i+k)%n]
        solver.add_clause([-b, y1, -y2])
        solver.add_clause([-b, -y1, y2])
        solver.add_clause([b, y1, y2])
        solver.add_clause([b, -y1, -y2])
        
    cnf_eq = CardEnc.equals(lits=eq_vars, bound=22, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
    vpool = cnf_eq.nv
    for clause in cnf_eq.clauses:
        solver.add_clause(clause)

# Symmetry breaking: fix x[0] = 1, y[0] = 1
solver.add_clause([x_vars[0]])
solver.add_clause([y_vars[0]])

print("Solving...")
if solver.solve():
    print("SAT")
    model = solver.get_model()
    x_val = [1 if model[i-1] > 0 else -1 for i in x_vars]
    y_val = [1 if model[i-1] > 0 else -1 for i in y_vars]
    print(x_val + y_val)
else:
    print("UNSAT")

from pysat.formula import IDPool

n = 23
vpool = IDPool()

solver = Glucose4()

x_vars = [vpool.id(f'x_{i}') for i in range(n)]
y_vars = [vpool.id(f'y_{i}') for i in range(n)]

cnf_x = CardEnc.equals(lits=x_vars, bound=12, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
for clause in cnf_x.clauses:
    solver.add_clause(clause)

cnf_y = CardEnc.equals(lits=y_vars, bound=12, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
for clause in cnf_y.clauses:
    solver.add_clause(clause)

for k in range(1, 12):
    eq_vars = []
    for i in range(n):
        a = vpool.id(f'a_{k}_{i}')
        eq_vars.append(a)
        x1 = x_vars[i]
        x2 = x_vars[(i+k)%n]
        solver.add_clause([-a, x1, -x2])
        solver.add_clause([-a, -x1, x2])
        solver.add_clause([a, x1, x2])
        solver.add_clause([a, -x1, -x2])
        
        b = vpool.id(f'b_{k}_{i}')
        eq_vars.append(b)
        y1 = y_vars[i]
        y2 = y_vars[(i+k)%n]
        solver.add_clause([-b, y1, -y2])
        solver.add_clause([-b, -y1, y2])
        solver.add_clause([b, y1, y2])
        solver.add_clause([b, -y1, -y2])
        
    cnf_eq = CardEnc.equals(lits=eq_vars, bound=22, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
    for clause in cnf_eq.clauses:
        solver.add_clause(clause)

# Symmetry breaking: fix x[0] = 1, y[0] = 1
solver.add_clause([x_vars[0]])
solver.add_clause([y_vars[0]])

print("Solving...")
if solver.solve():
    print("SAT")
    model = solver.get_model()
    model_set = set(model)
    x_val = [1 if v in model_set else -1 for v in x_vars]
    y_val = [1 if v in model_set else -1 for v in y_vars]
    print(x_val + y_val)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
